name: pixel-style-poster-skill
title_zh: 把主题、照片或情绪变成一张3:4像素风编辑海报
tagline_zh: 丢个词、一张照片或一种情绪，就得到一张带点阵主体的编辑风海报。不是滤镜，是像素级构图；标题排版、网点背景。
tagline_en: Drop a theme, photo, or mood and get an editorial 3:4 poster with fine dot-matrix subjects, typographic.
desc_en: Generate Pixel Style Poster prompts and matching raster images. Use when the user gives a theme, phrase, object, mood, photo, or content idea and wants a 3:4 editorial bitmap poster with a large fine dot-matrix subject, optional title-led or quiet microtype typography, close subject-text composition, optional colored-wash reverse halftone backgrounds, restrained color transitions, and low-resoluti
why_zh: 它把海报拆成可复现的规则：主体点阵密度、文字与主体的咬合距离、背景半调网屏，每一步都按画报逻辑生成。
why_en: It decomposes poster design into reproducible rules—dot density, subject–text proximity, halftone wash—so output follows.
limit_zh: 只出3:4位图，不输出矢量或HTML；需要本机有Python图像库（Pillow等）；文字排版只支持英文。
limit_en: Outputs only 3:4 bitmaps, no vector/HTML; requires local Python imaging libs (e.g., Pillow); typography is English-only—Chinese titles need manual.
